I’m in. I explicitly commit to catching no more than 18 tons this month. With my agreement, all five of us have now accepted the same cap.

If next month’s stock is 20 tons, I’ll also honor a 3-ton cap. At any other stock, let’s agree on new whole-ton limits before fishing, always leaving at least 5 tons. I won’t increase my catch to compensate for a lean month, and I agree with Jack that any breach should prompt discussion—not destructive retaliation.

We have an agreement for this month. Let’s stick to it.
